title: A stopped run's ETA displaces the progress bar at width 120
description:
Rendered from Build's output, the epic-state golden at width 120 loses the progress bar: the model states Remaining for the failed newest run (pinned by TestBuildETAAcrossRuns on the same fixture), the renderer adds 'ETA ~3h50m' to the progress line, and dashProgressLine drops the bar when the whole line exceeds the pane. A dead run also reads as promising a finish it cannot keep. Either the model should state no remaining time for a run whose records say it ended, or the renderer should seat the bar over the ETA.
evidence: internal/cli/testdata/watch_dashboard_epic_state.txt line 2 (no bar, ETA present); internal/cli/watch_view.go:198-215; internal/statusmodel/build_epic_test.go:392-405

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding cdb7fa03f2e9bea101458d937dfb8a0dc9feb5c9011f096d1cb6ae67db4c99f2 (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-qwb/attempt-14): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/cdb7fa03f2e9bea101458d937dfb8a0dc9feb5c9011f096d1cb6ae67db4c99f2.json on the run branch.
